attribution.documentation: Aggregate projection and file-hash/arithmetic checks only; no reaction rerun, model inference or campaign execution.
attribution.evaluator: Parent reviewer; direct catalog/registry lookup, route-graph traversal and RDKit reaction replay without project imports.
attribution.shared_kernel: Uses the same RDKit reaction execution, parsing and stereochemistry kernel; not independent physical or experimental chemistry validation.

limitations: Post hoc completed-primary snapshot; not the full 630-attempt campaign or an efficacy comparison.
Only returned successful-attempt candidates are replayed; timeouts and other failures remain outside candidate replay and retain their attempt statuses.
Direct route traversal and registry/catalog lookups do not import project modules, but use the same RDKit reaction execution and stereochemistry kernel.
Reaction match proves consistency with supplied templates and catalog snapshot, not current stock, reagent/condition completeness, yield, selectivity, activity, or experimental synthesis success.
Repeated route occurrences are not independent syntheses; missing routes are reported separately rather than treated as successful or failed reaction replay.

Matched routes include the reported atom-map provenance gaps; replay agreement does not establish fully atom-sourced synthesis. Omitted mapping and unrepresented reagents remain possible explanations, without fabricated reagent attribution.
Forward-model agreement is not experimental yield. No complete reagent/condition, current-stock, selectivity, activity-retention or experimental synthesis-success claim is made.

The original 630-attempt comparison was pending at this snapshot; incomplete method counts must not be ranked as method performance. No confidence interval, significance or superiority inference is added.

observation_units.distinct_input_definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON serialization of [route graph, returned product string]. This is not a count of independent syntheses or chemically unique routes.
observation_units.failed_attempt_handling: Timeout, no-candidate and infrastructure-interruption attempts retain their original statuses; no returned candidates are invented for them. Infrastructure interruption is not a chemistry failure.
observation_units.method_counts_interpretation: Incomplete method cohorts in a read-time snapshot; descriptive coverage only, not a ranking or efficacy comparison.
observation_units.no_route_handling: Reported separately; neither a successful nor a failed reaction replay.
observation_units.scope: All candidate occurrences returned by successful completed primary attempts visible in these three snapshots; failed attempts retained in coverage counts; post hoc software-consistency assessment

provenance.public_payload: Aggregate counts, named control scenarios and local hash provenance only; no raw molecular strings, per-candidate arrays or source reaction templates.

provenance_checks.input_pin_timing: Before and after the parent post hoc assessment; not before and after the original experiment.
provenance_checks.response_check_scope: After-assessment cross-check of immutable successful-attempt response files against the snapshotted hash and parsed response; no model inference or reaction rerun.

controls.rejection: Declared intermediate not reproduced within replay cap
Returned candidate differs from replayed root

replay_checks.interpretation: Consistency with the pinned catalog and supplied templates within the explicit enumeration bounds; not an exhaustive chemistry proof.
replay_checks.loaded_asset_scope: Loading 238542 catalog rows and 91 registered rules does not independently chemically validate every molecule or rule.
replay_checks.method: Resolve catalog and registered-rule IDs directly; traverse the route graph; check graph integrity, ordered reactants, declared intermediates and exact returned/evaluated product identities by direct RDKit reaction enumeration; compare supplied route-evidence fields when present.

template_atom_map_provenance.explicit_policy_detail: All 3 affected pipeline_no_3d candidates had external-evidence eligibility true, declared implicit sources and require_explicit_atom_sources=false; 28 reaction_enumeration occurrences supplied no external-evidence eligibility.
template_atom_map_provenance.interpretation: Missing explicit reactant atom-map provenance can reflect omitted mapping or an unrepresented reagent source. It does not by itself prove an impossible reaction or physically invented atoms.
template_atom_map_provenance.mapping_gap_definition: Reaction-product template heavy atoms without an explicit map to any reactant-template atom.
template_atom_map_provenance.policy_observation: All affected pipeline candidates supplied an implicit-source flag and used a policy that did not require explicit atom sources. Bare reaction-enumeration candidates supplied no external-evidence eligibility claim.
